title: Understanding Loss Functions
text: Loss functions are used to measure how well a model's predictions match the actual data. They help in optimizing the model parameters.

title: Mean Squared Error (MSE)
text: MSE is a common loss function that calculates the average of the squares of the errors. It is given by 1/n*sum{i o n}{(y_i-y_i)**2}.

title: Penalizing Outliers
text: Loss functions that use higher powers or absolute values of errors tend to penalize outliers more harshly than MSE.
